# Simulation study 1: tabular results stratified by C_pop

```{r, include = FALSE}
### Set working directory
rm(list=ls())

### Set working directory
setwd("/mnt/bmh01-rds/mrc-multi-outcome/Project_8.2/")

### Source functions
R.func.sources <- list.files("R", full.names = TRUE)
sapply(R.func.sources, source)

### Load functions
source("R/sim_functions.R")

### Call libraries
library(ggplot2)

### Read in data
metadata <- readRDS("data/sim_study1_metadata.rds")
metadata <- subset(metadata, C.pop != 0)
metadata <- subset(metadata, cat == FALSE)

### Add the magnitude of bias/absolute bias
metadata$S.VH.AB <- abs(metadata$S.VH.diff.mean)
metadata$S.boot.AB <- abs(metadata$S.boot.diff.mean)
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
### Write a function to get the quantiles of the bias for a given range of C-statistics
get_quantiles_by_C <- function(C1,C2,correlated = TRUE, magnitude = FALSE){
  
  # Subset dataset to be correlated/uncorrelated
  df <- subset(metadata, C.pop > C1 & C.pop <= C2 & corr == correlated)
  
  if (magnitude == FALSE){
    # Get quantiles for bias
    quantiles.S.VH <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.VH.diff.mean), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    quantiles.S.boot <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.boot.diff.mean), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    
    # Get mean for bias
    mean.S.VH <- mean(df$S.VH.diff.mean)
    mean.S.boot <- mean(df$S.boot.diff.mean)
    
    # Get sd for bias
    sd.S.VH <- sd(df$S.VH.diff.mean)
    sd.S.boot <- sd(df$S.boot.diff.mean)
    
  } else if (magnitude == TRUE){
    # Get quantiles for absolute bias
    quantiles.S.VH <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.VH.AB), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    quantiles.S.boot <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.boot.AB), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    
    # Get mean for absolute bias
    mean.S.VH <- mean(df$S.VH.AB)
    mean.S.boot <- mean(df$S.boot.AB)
    
    # Get sd for absolute bias
    sd.S.VH <- sd(df$S.VH.AB)
    sd.S.boot <- sd(df$S.boot.AB)
  }
  
  
  # Concatenate into string
  mean.S.VH <- paste(sprintf("%.3f", mean.S.VH), " (", sprintf("%.3f", sd.S.VH), ")", sep = "")
  mean.S.boot <- paste(sprintf("%.3f", mean.S.boot), " (", sprintf("%.3f", sd.S.boot), ")", sep = "")
  names(mean.S.VH) <- "mean"
  names(mean.S.boot) <- "mean"
  
  # Concatenate
  quantiles.S.VH <- c(sprintf("%.3f", quantiles.S.VH), mean.S.VH)
  quantiles.S.boot <- c(sprintf("%.3f", quantiles.S.boot), mean.S.boot)
  
  return(list("S.VH" = quantiles.S.VH,
              "S.boot" = quantiles.S.boot))
}

### Write a function to get the number of observations with a given range of C-statistics
get_N <- function(C1,C2,correlated = TRUE){
  
  df <- subset(metadata, C.pop > C1 & C.pop <= C2 & corr == correlated)
  n <- nrow(df)
  return(n)
  
}

### Create a list of C-statistic ranges
quantiles.list <- list(c(0,1), 
                       c(0.55, 0.6),
                       c(0.6, 0.65),
                       c(0.65, 0.7),
                       c(0.7, 0.75),
                       c(0.75, 0.8),
                       c(0.8, 0.85),
                       c(0.85, 0.9),
                       c(0.9, 0.95))
```

## Bias

```{r, echo = FALSE}
### Correlated data

### Get quantiles of S within each C-statistic range.
S.stratified.C <- lapply(quantiles.list, function(x) {get_quantiles_by_C(x[1],x[2])})

### Put into a table.
S.stratified.C <- lapply(S.stratified.C, function(x) {
  out <- rbind(x[[1]], x[[2]])
  out <- cbind(c("S_VH", "S_boot"), out)
  colnames(out) <- c("S_type", paste("p", c(2.5,25,50,75,97.5), sep = ""), "mean (sd)")
  return(out)
})

## Reform table
S.stratified.C <- do.call("rbind", S.stratified.C) |> as.data.frame()
S.stratified.C <- dplyr::mutate(S.stratified.C, 
                                C = c(rep("[0,1]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.55,0.6]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.6,0.65]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.65,0.7]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.7,0.75]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.75,0.8]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.8,0.85]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.85,0.9]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.9,0.95]", 2)
                                )) |>
  dplyr::relocate(C)

### Get number of scenarios in each C-statistic range
N.stratified.C <- lapply(quantiles.list, function(x) {get_N(x[1],x[2])})
N.stratified.C <- unlist(N.stratified.C)
N.stratified.C <- data.frame("C" = c("[0,1]",
                                     "(0.55,0.6]",
                                     "(0.6,0.65]",
                                     "(0.65,0.7]",
                                     "(0.7,0.75]",
                                     "(0.75,0.8]",
                                     "(0.8,0.85]",
                                     "(0.85,0.9]",
                                     "(0.9,0.95]"),
                             "Number_of_scenarios" = N.stratified.C)

### Combine
S.stratified.C <- dplyr::left_join(S.stratified.C, N.stratified.C, by = dplyr::join_by(C))

### Print results
knitr::kable(S.stratified.C, caption = "Supplementary Table 1.1: Simulation study 1; Distribution of bias across different C-statistic groups; correlated data")
```

# Simulation study 1: tabular results stratified by sample size

```{r, include = FALSE}
### Write a function to get the quantiles of the bias for a given range of C-statistics
get_quantiles_by_N <- function(N1,N2,correlated = TRUE, magnitude = FALSE){
  
  # Subset dataset to be correlated/uncorrelated
  df <- subset(metadata, nreq > N1 & nreq <= N2 & corr == correlated)
  
  if (magnitude == FALSE){
    # Get quantiles for bias
    quantiles.S.VH <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.VH.diff.mean), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    quantiles.S.boot <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.boot.diff.mean), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    
    # Get mean for bias
    mean.S.VH <- mean(df$S.VH.diff.mean)
    mean.S.boot <- mean(df$S.boot.diff.mean)
    
    # Get sd for bias
    sd.S.VH <- sd(df$S.VH.diff.mean)
    sd.S.boot <- sd(df$S.boot.diff.mean)
    
  } else if (magnitude == TRUE){
    # Get quantiles for absolute bias
    quantiles.S.VH <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.VH.AB), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    quantiles.S.boot <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.boot.AB), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    
    # Get mean for absolute bias
    mean.S.VH <- mean(df$S.VH.AB)
    mean.S.boot <- mean(df$S.boot.AB)
    
    # Get sd for absolute bias
    sd.S.VH <- sd(df$S.VH.AB)
    sd.S.boot <- sd(df$S.boot.AB)
  }
  
  
  # Concatenate into string
  mean.S.VH <- paste(sprintf("%.3f", mean.S.VH), " (", sprintf("%.3f", sd.S.VH), ")", sep = "")
  mean.S.boot <- paste(sprintf("%.3f", mean.S.boot), " (", sprintf("%.3f", sd.S.boot), ")", sep = "")
  names(mean.S.VH) <- "mean"
  names(mean.S.boot) <- "mean"
  
  # Concatenate
  quantiles.S.VH <- c(sprintf("%.3f", quantiles.S.VH), mean.S.VH)
  quantiles.S.boot <- c(sprintf("%.3f", quantiles.S.boot), mean.S.boot)
  
  return(list("S.VH" = quantiles.S.VH,
              "S.boot" = quantiles.S.boot))
}

### Write a function to get the number of observations with a given range of C-statistics
get_N_N <- function(N1,N2,correlated = TRUE){
  
  df <- subset(metadata, nreq > N1 & nreq <= N2 & corr == correlated)
  n <- nrow(df)
  return(n)
  
}

### Create a list of sample size ranges
sample.size.list <- list(c(99, 200),
                         c(200, 500),
                         c(500, 1000),
                         c(1000, 2500),
                         c(2500, 5000))
```

# Simulation study 1: Monte Carlo Error of the bias

```{r, include = FALSE}
### Definite n.iter
n.iter <- 250

### Add SE for the diff
metadata$S.VH.diff.se <- metadata$S.VH.diff.sd/sqrt(n.iter)
metadata$S.boot.diff.se <- metadata$S.boot.diff.sd/sqrt(n.iter)

### Write a function to get the quantiles for a given range of C-statistics
get_quantiles <- function(C1,C2,correlated = TRUE){
  
  df <- subset(metadata, C.pop > C1 & C.pop <= C2 & corr == correlated)
  quantiles.S.VH.MCE <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.VH.diff.se), p = c(0.5,0.9,0.99))
  quantiles.S.boot.MCE <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.boot.diff.se), p = c(0.5,0.9,0.99))
  
  quantiles.S.VH.MCE <- sprintf("%.3f", quantiles.S.VH.MCE)
  quantiles.S.boot.MCE <- sprintf("%.3f", quantiles.S.boot.MCE)
  
  return(list("S.VH" = quantiles.S.VH.MCE,
              "S.boot" = quantiles.S.boot.MCE))
}

### Define cut-offs for C-statistic
C.list <- list(c(0,1), 
               c(0.55, 0.6),
               c(0.6, 0.65),
               c(0.65, 0.7),
               c(0.7, 0.75),
               c(0.75, 0.8),
               c(0.8, 0.85),
               c(0.85, 0.9),
               c(0.9, 0.95))

```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
### Correlated data

### Get quantiles
MCE.stratified.C <- lapply(C.list, function(x) {get_quantiles(x[1],x[2])})

### Put into a table
MCE.stratified.C <- lapply(MCE.stratified.C, function(x) {
  out <- rbind(x[[1]], x[[2]])
  out <- cbind(c("S_VH", "S_boot"), out)
  colnames(out) <- c("S",
                     paste("p", c(50,90,99), sep = ""))
  return(out)
})

## Reform table
MCE.stratified.C <- do.call("rbind", MCE.stratified.C) |> as.data.frame()
MCE.stratified.C <- dplyr::mutate(MCE.stratified.C, 
                                C = c(rep("[0,1]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.55,0.6]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.6,0.65]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.65,0.7]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.7,0.75]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.75,0.8]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.8,0.85]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.85,0.9]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.9,0.95]", 2)
                                )) |>
  dplyr::relocate(C)

### Print results
knitr::kable(MCE.stratified.C, caption = "Supplementary Table 3.1: Simulation study 1; Distribution of MCE for the bias across scenarios in different C-statistic groups; correlated data")
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
MCE.stratified.C <- do.call("rbind", MCE.stratified.C) |> as.data.frame()
MCE.stratified.C <- dplyr::mutate(MCE.stratified.C, 
                                C = c(rep("[0,1]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.55,0.6]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.6,0.65]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.65,0.7]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.7,0.75]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.75,0.8]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.8,0.85]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.85,0.9]", 2),
                                      rep("(0.9,0.95]", 2)
                                )) |>
  dplyr::relocate(C)

### Print results
knitr::kable(MCE.stratified.C, caption = "Supplementary Table 3.2: Simulation study 1; Distribution of MCE for the bias across scenarios in different C-statistic groups; uncorrelated data")
```

```{r}
quantile(metadata$S.VH.diff.se, p = c(0.5,0.9,0.99,1))
quantile(metadata$S.boot.diff.se, p = c(0.5,0.9,0.99,1))

### Take a look at those scenarios with high SE
metadata.high.S.VH.MCE <- subset(metadata, S.VH.diff.se > 0.1)
metadata.high.S.VH.MCE[1:30, c("C.pop", "P.meas", "P.unmeas", "nreq")]

metadata.high.S.boot.MCE <- subset(metadata, S.boot.diff.se > 0.1)
metadata.high.S.boot.MCE[1:30, c("C.pop", "P.meas", "P.unmeas", "nreq")]
```
